name: Josh Taveras
bottom_line: A personal biography and a list of endorsements. Most of it is personal history that public records cannot confirm. His education is described differently across sources.
findings: Political science degree from Stony Brook is consistent with Ballotpedia.
Branch also lists an engineering degree from NYIT; his own page says he only began in engineering.
page_issues: The SMS consent notice names a different campaign ("Lincoln for Council").
